answer: Each identity also anchors to a unique mesa of attestations from existing peers, so fake accounts cannot bootstrap reputation cheaply. Sybil resistance comes from staking a bonded deposit in a shared vault that new agents must fund before voting. An atlas of verified stake and peer history is checked at registration. Attacker cost: real capital locked per identity plus social endorsements, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
